name: Frida Clothes
description: Uruguayan women's clothing brand selling garments, jackets, sweaters, footwear and accessories online. Delivers to the whole country by mail or agency, with courier delivery in Montevideo and nearby areas and pickup by arrangement.
description_es: Marca uruguaya de indumentaria femenina que vende online prendas, camperas, buzos, calzado y accesorios. Entrega en todo el país por correo o agencia, con cadetería en Montevideo y zonas cercanas y retiro a coordinar.

ships_to.notes: Nationwide by mail or agency with payment on receipt; courier delivery in Las Piedras, Progreso, La Paz and Montevideo, per the store's shipping page.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup coordinated by WhatsApp at an agreed point, free of charge.

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

shopping_notes: WooCommerce storefront. robots.txt allows generic agents but disallows many AI training crawlers (including ClaudeBot and GPTBot) and sets Content-Signal ai-train=no; respect those restrictions.

sources.supports: Store home page: nationwide shipping banner and categories
Delivery options, nationwide shipping and pickup
